report.title: Security file — {domain}
report.method_text: Passive scan: DNS queries, reading of the certificates the website presents and of the headers of its home page. No intrusion test was run and nothing was changed. The score goes from 0 to 100: each check has a weight according to its importance; a point to improve counts half, a critical point zero. Checks that do not apply (no website, internal audit) are left out. Those that could not run (server unreachable, timeout, destination refused) are listed and lower the coverage: below 50% coverage no score is given; below 90%, the grade cannot be better than B.

mc.intro: Understand observations, explore hypotheses and choose the next action.
mc.score_scope: This score concerns the checks measured on this domain, not the security of your entire information system.
mc.withheld: The grade is withheld: HTTPS availability remains undetermined.
mc.no_delta: No overall score change is asserted.
mc.no_changes: No new status transition is established between these states.
mc.status_history: History is limited to 30 states. Older states retain statuses, not every intermediate detailed proof. Links open the evidence currently available.
mc.last_conclusive: Last earlier conclusive verdict: {status}, on {date} at {time}; {n} intervening measurement(s) unavailable.
mc.dependency_help: The HTTPS service still prevents the measurements below. Their statuses do not establish whether those checks pass or fail.
mc.pure: Simulating does not check the domain, change any measurement or apply a fix. No DNS, HTTP or TLS request is sent; no event is opened or resolved.
mc.select: Select the first steps to assume completed
mc.no_candidates: No remediation is currently selectable. Unavailable measurements do not become corrective tasks.
mc.empty_selection: No remediation selected: the observed assessment is retained.
mc.conditional: Pessimistic and optimistic scenarios if the unblocked checks become measurable. A later measurement may still error: these bounds do not guarantee the next score. The lower bound may be below the current score.
mc.unknown_help: The effect of at least one step cannot be established reliably; no target score is asserted.
mc.conditional_delta: Conditional difference from the observation: {low} to {high} points.
mc.future_measurements: These checks would require a new actual measurement:
mc.fallback: Registry verdicts unavailable for {check}: FAIL is a pessimistic fallback assumption, not an observation.
mc.not_prediction: The result depends on all selected assumptions and their prerequisites. It is neither a measurement nor a certain prediction.
mc.verify_separate: Open an action to read its instructions and then run an actual check with the Verify button. Simulation is a separate operation.
mc.events_separate: Events and measurement transitions are distinct information. This page does not resolve events or attribute a cause to an incident.

mc.reason.legacy: The legacy state does not support this comparison.
mc.reason.engine: Rules generation differs or is unknown.
